  • stack-gap — Two spacing steps are half a rem, so 8px at the default root size.
  • stack-padding-inline-start — A logical edge keeps the padding on the start side in RTL.
  • stack-padding-block-start — The block axis has no theme scale, so the class names the property.
  • grid-template-columns-variable — Three fixed tracks, written on the element so a rule can override them.
  • grid-template-columns-class — The class reads the variable, so the two cannot drift apart.
  • center-height — The centre is 300 by 120 and centres its child on both axes.
